description: Fork of exp722 (E=384, d_v=64, residual/emb_resid NAP=6, out_proj NAP=6, bs=16 8K = 1.4054 @ 201.33M). Two changes: (1) out_input_nap 6 -> 7 (2x more candidate rows per table in out_proj: 64 -> 128); (2) compute scaled to bs=48 16K = 393M tokens (exp712 regime). out_proj /layer = 1*512*128*384 = 25.17M (was 12.58M); block out_proj × 6 = +75.5M. Expected ~276.8M params. Tests if NAP=7 on out_proj (in addition to NAP=6 on residual modules) lands a new high-compute SOTA. Comparison anchors: exp712 (out_proj NAP=6, residual NAP=5, same compute) = 1.2080 @ 179.32M; exp722 (NAP=6 residuals, NAP=6 out_proj, 65.5M tok) = 1.4054 @ 201.33M.
